subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp suppress typing for every unmentioned automatic-delivery group run, or should this wait for the broader visible-delivery-start boundary?
rationale: Both paths address the false silent-run typing signal, but they make different UX and API tradeoffs for proactive visible replies in unmentioned groups.

options.title: Prefer visible-delivery boundary
options.body: Let the broader WhatsApp typing fix own the behavior so typing starts only when a visible platform send is actually beginning.

options.title: Accept narrow suppression
options.body: Land this smaller mitigation after rebasing it onto current main's `conversationKind` and `groupMention` facts, accepting missing typing before rare proactive visible replies.

options.title: Keep current shipped boundary
options.body: Reject the broader suppression if maintainers want automatic unmentioned visible replies to keep the current typing behavior until a structural fix lands.

recommendation.title: Prefer visible-delivery boundary
recommendation.body: Let the broader WhatsApp typing fix own the behavior so typing starts only when a visible platform send is actually beginning.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the open broader visible-delivery typing PR that frames the same product boundary.
